title: Bluegrass Jam @ Gracie's
event_description: Weekly bluegrass performances featuring local and touring bands with on-stage jam sessions on second and last Tuesdays. Hosted by Hot House West and Trash Moon Collective House Band.
venue_address: 326 S West Temple St Salt Lake City UT 84101
hosts: Hot House West Trash Moon Collective
event_venue_information:
About Gracie's

Gracie's is a downtown Salt Lake City gastropub established in 2009 that has become a cornerstone of the local music scene. The venue offers a welcoming atmosphere for music lovers and musicians alike with a full bar and quality pub food.

Music Events

In addition to the weekly bluegrass Tuesday series Gracie's hosts live music and DJs nearly every night of the week. The venue features an excellent rooftop patio and has earned recognition as one of SLC's best neighborhood bars and downtown escapes.

Venue Features

The venue includes pool tables big screen TVs and both indoor and outdoor seating. Gracie's is known for its community-driven atmosphere and support of local musicians across multiple genres including rock jazz blues and reggae.

title: IAMA Acoustic Showcase @ Pat's BBQ
event_description: Monthly acoustic showcase featuring Utah's local talent performing original songs and creative covers. This is a platform for singer-songwriters and acoustic musicians to share their craft.
venue_address: 155 W Commonwealth Ave Salt Lake City UT 84115
event_venue_information:
About Pat's BBQ

Pat's BBQ has been serving award-winning barbecue since 2004 and has become a vital part of Salt Lake City's music scene. The restaurant features Howie's Hall which hosts live music Thursday through Saturday nights.

Music Programming

Pat's regularly features local and touring bands across genres and has become known for supporting the acoustic music community through events like the IAMA Acoustic Showcase. The venue provides a casual comfortable atmosphere where diners can enjoy quality BBQ while experiencing live performances.

Accolades

Voted Best BBQ and Best Catering Company in 2023 and featured on Food Network's Diners Drive-ins and Dives. The venue offers free party room usage and has established itself as a premier destination for both food and music in Salt Lake City.

title: Open Mic @ Alchemy Coffee
event_description: Weekly open mic for original music only - no cover songs allowed. Rotating hosts from IAMA and the community create a supportive environment for songwriters and original artists.
venue_address: 390 E 1700 S Salt Lake City UT 84115
event_venue_information:
About Alchemy Coffee

Alchemy Coffee is a unique coffee shop in Salt Lake City established in 2005 known for its spooky eclectic decor and community-focused atmosphere. The shop uses only organic beans from Salt Lake Roasting Company.

Music and Arts

Every Tuesday Alchemy hosts an open mic night from 6-9 PM that focuses exclusively on original music. The venue has also hosted after-hours art shows and features rotating local artwork on its walls. The coffee shop has become a gathering place for artists musicians and the community.

Atmosphere

Known for having the comfiest couches in Salt Lake City Alchemy offers a cozy welcoming space decorated with skeletons and hauntingly beautiful art year-round. The shop is dog-friendly and provides free WiFi making it an ideal spot for working or relaxing while enjoying quality organic coffee.

title: Stage Presence Open Mic @ Clubhouse
event_description: Weekly community open mic showcase featuring spoken word musical performances comedy and original creative works. A platform for performers of all levels in an intimate historic venue.
venue_address: 850 E South Temple St Salt Lake City UT 84102
backline: Stage piano and guitar 1-3 mics available
event_venue_information:
About Clubhouse

Clubhouse is a historic event venue located in downtown Salt Lake City originally built by the Ladies' Literary Club of Utah in 1913. It stands as one of the best examples of Prairie School style architecture in Utah.

Programming

The venue is committed to uplifting local Salt Lake communities through creative programming historic preservation and educational opportunities. Stage Presence is their weekly community open mic that welcomes spoken word music poetry philosophy storytelling improv and comedy.

Additional Events

Beyond the weekly open mic Clubhouse hosts live figure drawing darkroom rentals jazz performances and various cultural events. The venue is available for weddings corporate parties wellness events photoshoots and musical performances. Entry is $15 or 2 for $20.

title: Open Mic @ Sugar House Coffee
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring local musicians and performers in Salt Lake City's vibrant Sugar House neighborhood. A welcoming LGBTQ+ friendly space with talented performers.
venue_address: 2011 S 1100 E Salt Lake City UT 84106
event_venue_information:
About Sugar House Coffee

Sugar House Coffee is the beloved independent coffee shop in the heart of the Sugar House neighborhood. Established as a community hub the shop is known for its welcoming atmosphere exceptional coffee and commitment to local artists.

Community Events

In addition to the weekly Tuesday open mic the shop hosts board game nights and bi-monthly Makers Markets. The venue features a piano that patrons sometimes play and offers a variety of specialty drinks including the popular White Witch spicy chai and creative custom concoctions.

Atmosphere and Values

The shop is proudly LGBTQ+ friendly and has created a safe inclusive space for all. With cozy seating options both indoor and outdoor free WiFi and locally-sourced organic vegan and gluten-free food options Sugar House Coffee has become more than just a coffee shop - it's a true community gathering place in Salt Lake City.

title: Monday Night Open Jam @ Hog Wallow Pub
event_description: Weekly open jam session where musicians can sign up and jam in a rustic mountain pub atmosphere. The venue features regular live music Wednesday through Saturday with genres including rock jazz blues and reggae.
venue_address: 3200 E Big Cottonwood Canyon Rd Salt Lake City UT 84121
event_venue_information:
About Hog Wallow Pub

The Hog Wallow Pub is a legendary watering hole established in 1947 located at the base of Big Cottonwood Canyon. Secluded among pine trees this 21+ venue is the latest incarnation of the oldest and most notorious bar in the Cottonwood Heights area.

Live Music

The venue features live music Wednesday through Sunday with Monday night dedicated to open jam sessions. Musical styles include rock jazz blues reggae bluegrass and Americana. The pub has received numerous awards including City Weekly's Best Neighborhood Bar and Best Escape From Downtown.

Venue Character

Housed in a cozy log cabin with an intricate wood carving behind the bar Hog Wallow offers an extensive spirits beer and wine list along with elevated pub food. The venue features a popular outdoor patio and has become a favorite après-ski destination and mountain community gathering place.
